caption: Day 2: 100 Days of Crazy Advertisements
transcript: Do you know Swiggy once offered free food for an entire year to anyone who could make their voice notes look like a kabab? This is day two of 100 days of crazy advertisements. So back in 2019, Instagram had just launched voice notes and every single voice note used to look like this. Now Swiggy noticed something very interesting with the right kind of sounds. Sound waves would start looking exactly like food shapes. So they launched something very interesting called the voice of hunger. Each round basically gave people a food shape like a kabab, a nacho, a sharma etc. And people basically had to use voice notes in order to make those shapes on Instagram. And that's exactly where it gets very funny because there is no normal way to make your voice note look like a kabab, right? You'll literally have to sit there and do something like this. And the funniest thing is how Swiggy started this
